SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Start at Boot
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Automatically run DFRoot on device boot

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Auto Soft Reboot
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Applies to both Manual Start and Start at Boot.\nNOTE: this will only work if your SU manager supports it as a late-load arg

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Disable Modules
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Marks every KernelSU module disabled before the next boot. Turn this on if a broken module bootloops your device
